title: Numbers One to Ten
label: ch:ta-numbers-one-to-ten
canDo: I can hear, say, read, and write representative numbers from one to ten in Tamil and recognize their Dravidian family history.

payoff.summary: Count onru to pattu, read the ten Tamil numeral shapes out of order, write eezhu with its numeral from sound alone, and recall the pattu/hattu relationship.
